eps.d: Painter and decorator Jacko gets into a spot of bother after forgetfully arranging two dates on the same night. At least they're in the same pub!
Jacko further complicates his life by getting involved with a novice nun, the new office secretary and a mystery girl at a tennis club.

Jacko lives in fear of discovery - unwittingly he's taken out the boss's daughter and left her stranded when he found out who she was. If Lionel finds out he'll kill him - if Lesley finds out she'll kill him. Solace comes with Julie.
Jacko's charm is not working too well. Another date with the boss's secretary Sandra ends in disaster and the dark secret concerning Lionel's daughter nears discovery.
Lionel is determined to stop Jacko's relationship with his daughter Leslie but a chance meeting between Jacko and brother Reg may do the job for him.
Lionel's daughter Leslie is on a forced separation from Jacko in America, and Jacko returns from hospital to start back to work. But, for some reason, his old charm is not working with the ladies.

Lionel is planning to extend his business but there are provisos. While Jacko's worries are two-fold, Lesley continues to pursue him and he has to find out whether Veronica's overtures are intentional.
Jacko is still being pursued by Lesley, but Veronica has a bust up with Lionel and needs a shoulder to cry on. Jacko turns to Sandra for some solace.
Celia, the runaway nun Jacko helped, needs a place to stay. Jacko finds her proximity in the flat somewhat disconcerting and becomes a runaway himself.
Jacko develops his outside interests and meets Linda. Meanwhile Lionel loses his most precious possession.
Jacko is flying high with Gaynor, a stewardess. Meanwhile Lionel celebrates his extension of family, but for Veronica the party is over.
Jacko remembers the devious past of Sandra's new boyfriend. The boss misses his wife about the house.
Veronica returns, while Lionel wallows in self-pity and Philip becomes the man his nanny said he would be.
Lionel is in seventh heaven now that his wife has returned - but Lesley is far from happy with the new arrangement.
Jacko tries to do right by a customer and incurs Lionel's wrath. Sandra continues to refuse his advances but is upset when he takes a redhead to a party.
Jacko goes on a secret painting mission and becomes embroiled in private family business.
Sandra continues to hold out against Jacko's advances and an old mate of his returns from Canada with a new lifestyle. The argument for married life is displayed to Jacko, but can he be convinced?
Fifth episode of the second series of this comedy about cheeky painter and decorator Jacko.
Sandra is leaving the company and Lionel senses that her hasty departure is caused by Jacko. He advertises her job and Jacko has to move fast to reverse the situation.
Lesley's job isn't working and Lionel can't resist interfering. Jacko makes a decision that will change his life.
Jacko has made a life-changing decision, but what will the consequences be for him and those around him?
Jacko and Sandra are on honeymoon in Barbados - but find themselves there under rather strange circumstances.
Jacko and Sandra make a big decision about their future together - but Lionel cannot believe it was mutual.
After becoming a free man once more, Jacko considers the direction his life in general is taking.
Veronica manages to convince Lionel and Lesley that Jacko must be taken as a serious threat to the Bainbridge business.
Jacko realises what the missing piece of the jigsaw is in his life, and rushes off to claim it - but will he succeed?
There's never a dull moment in Jacko's life - and he's in for a few surprises when it comes to his friends and workmates.
Jacko decides to go back to working for Veronica at Bainbridges. He also has a run in with the law, when he tries to help Gloria out. Elmo decides to open a winebar.
Elmo's wine bar opens to some decidedly mixed reactions, while Jacko and Eric make an Italian connection.
Jacko continues his pursuit of Lucia, and is allowed to call upon her at her home. Unfortunately this means sitting through hundreds of family photographs!
Jacko goes out wth Lucia and finds that she is not the shrinking violet that he thought she was. Lesley gets a job in a wine bar.
Jacko finds himself in a desperate predicament, and forced to extreme lengths to get himself out of trouble.

Everybody goes to Giles and Gloria's country mansion. Veronica and Marcello return to Leslie's dismay. Mr. Morella tells Jacko that he cannot Lucia as she is to marry somebody else. Paulette convinces Elmo to buy her a country house.

Everybody else can see that Paulette is continuing to be a gold digger but Elmo is blind to it. Eventually Elmo sees Paulette with another man and he sends her away. Veronica is very happy with Marcello but she has become distracted.

Jean and Eric announce that they are expecting another baby. Sandra and Jimmy have a row and they break up. Veronica announces that Marcello is moving in with her, which upsets Leslie. Jacko helps a woman in distress and then dates her.

Giles and Gloria are in London and organise a party at Elmo's. Everybody goes to the party to try and cheer up. Jacko new girlfriend plays for a soccer team but he breaks up with her because she is more interest in football than him.

Elmo buys a camera and Jacko suggests that Elmo make a promotional video for the wine bar. Jacko convinces everybody to participate but the results is not very good. Jacko talks Elmo into changing his mind.

Eric and Jean decide to move house and Jacko is upset. Elmo offers to let Jacko stay at his place. Veronica accepts Marcello's marriage proposal. They intend to live in Sicily and so Veronica is going to sell the business.

Veronica is having trouble selling Bainbridge's as a going concern. Eric and Jean manage to sell the house. Elmo is unhappy and Jacko takes him to a casino when he has winning streak, with the roulette table and the ladies.

Veronica decides not to sell the business and makes Sandra the new manager. She and Marcello finally head off to Sicily. Elmo buys a boat, takes off and makes Leslie the wine bar manager. Jacko gets two tempting offers of a place to stay.
